{
                "Part": 1,
                "Section": "B",
                "SectionName": "Planning, Budgeting, and Forecasting",
                "Topic": "B.017 production budget units 1",
                "MicroTopic": "production budget units 1",
                "UniqueConceptKey": "B-017-production-budget-units-1",
                "LOSTag": "B.4 Annual profit plan and supporting schedules",
                "Difficulty": "Moderate",
                "ItemType": "MCQ",
                "ItemStyle": "single-select",
                "Stem": "Riverview expects sales of 12,130 units next month and wants ending finished goods inventory equal to 20% of the following month sales of 14,620 units. Beginning inventory is 2,420 units. What production is required?",
                "Choices": {
                        "A": "9,710 units",
                        "B": "15,054 units",
                        "C": "12,634 units",
                        "D": "14,550 units"
                },
                "CorrectChoice": "C",
                "ExplanationCorrect": "Production (units) = Budgeted sales + Desired ending finished goods inventory - Beginning finished goods inventory. Sales = 12,130 units. Desired ending inventory = 20% x 14,620 = 2,924 units. Beginning inventory = 2,420 units. Production = 12,130 + 2,924 - 2,420 = 12,634 units.",
                "StudyLinks": [
                        {
                                "label": "IMA CMA Learning Outcome Statements, Part 1 Section B",
                                "url": "https://prodcm.imanet.org/-/media/IMA/Files/Home/IMA-Certifications/CMA-Certification/2024-CMA-Learning-Outcome-Statement-Final.ashx"
                        },
                        {
                                "label": "OpenStax Managerial Accounting: Budgeting",
                                "url": "https://openstax.org/books/principles-managerial-accounting/pages/7-introduction"
                        }
                ],
                "SourceDescription": "Original CMA Part 1 exam-style practice. Not real CMA exam content and not copied from official samples.",
                "Part1OnlyFlag": true,
                "ReviewNote": "If missed or marked, review the linked study materials and rework the underlying concept without looking at the answer.",
                "QuestionID": "P1-B-017",
                "CalculationItem": true,
                "VerifiedChecks": [
                        "Mapped to CMA Part 1 Learning Outcome Statements effective September 1, 2024",
                        "Screened to exclude Part 2-only topics such as CVP, financial ratio analysis, capital budgeting, corporate finance, ERM, and ethics",
                        "Original practice item with unique micro-topic and stem",
                        "Answer key distribution balanced across A/B/C/D",
                        "Distractors written as plausible CMA-style traps"
                ],
                "ExplanationWrongA": "This choice equals sales (12,130) minus beginning inventory (2,420) = 9,710, omitting the desired ending inventory entirely. The formula requires adding desired ending inventory.",
                "ExplanationWrongB": "This choice equals sales (12,130) plus desired ending inventory (2,924) = 15,054, omitting the subtraction of beginning inventory (2,420). Both adjustments are needed.",
                "ExplanationWrongC": "",
                "ExplanationWrongD": "This choice equals sales (12,130) plus beginning inventory (2,420) = 14,550, incorrectly adding beginning inventory instead of subtracting it. The production budget formula is sales + desired ending inventory - beginning inventory.",
